corrections.now: populated on 13 axes, covering 3 agents: BENZIODARONE, PRENYLAMINE, PROBUCOL
corrections.cause: Generator bug. axis_drug (02_chembl_druggability_pipeline.py:182) read it from DRUG.withdrawn_agents, populated by ChEMBL's bulk chembl_id lookup, which per the export's own README does not carry withdrawal status. The corrected set came from a later by-name compound_search sweep and was never written back.
corrections.method: Derived offline from the inline [WITHDRAWN] tags in agents_flagged, which the by-name sweep did write. No ChEMBL re-query — this is a recovery of misplaced data, not new data.
corrections.corroboration: The 3 agents match the generator's own report text verbatim ('Withdrawn: benziodarone, prenylamine, probucol'). All 10 axes tiered 1b_approved_withdrawn_only are covered, with zero 1b axes left empty.
corrections.why_3_axes_are_tier_1: CALM1|INSR, CALM1|PDE1A and CALM1|PDE1C carry a withdrawn CALM1 agent but are tiered 1_approved_available because the PARTNER gene has a clean approved agent. Tier is the best tier among constituent genes, so a withdrawn agent on one end does not demote the axis.

reproducibility_limits: CHEMBL RELEASE IS UNKNOWN. The generator recorded no version. The tiers cannot be tied to a specific ChEMBL release, so even an identical re-query cannot be proven equivalent.
CLINICALTRIALS.GOV SNAPSHOT DATE IS THE ONLY PIN. Trial counts drift continuously.

ONE INPUT IS PERMANENTLY LOST. Genes with no ChEMBL mechanism record inherited approved/clinical agents from a prior-session artifact addressed only as UUID 34d720d0-5c16-46bb-92e6-d8d6b6a02ec3 (evidence_source == 'prior_reference_pass'). That file is not in this repo and cannot be recovered; those genes' tiers are not re-derivable even with network access.

THE MCP RESPONSE CACHES DID NOT SURVIVE. The generator's handoff/*.json files (chembl_targets, chembl_mechanisms, chembl_molecules, chembl_neuro_extra, agent_safety, glioma_trials) do not exist anywhere in the project.

GLIOMA-TRIAL COVERAGE IS BOUNDED BY A HAND-CURATED 20-AGENT LIST (see curated_agent_map_2026-08-07.json). An empty glioma_trials cell means no NAMED trial for a LISTED agent — not that no trial exists.

withdrawn_column_is_empty.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-19 in the active snapshot — see `corrections`. Still present, by design, in the superseded 2026-08-07 file.

column_semantics.tier_v2: Axis tier = best (lowest-ordinal) tier among constituent genes, ordered {'1_':1,'1b':1.5,'2_':2,'3_':3,'4_':4}. Genes are obtained by splitting the axis on '|' then each end on '_' to expand LIANA subunit complexes.
column_semantics.agents_flagged: 'GENE: AGENT (phase) [tag]; ...' joined by ' | '. '[WITHDRAWN]' takes precedence over '[black-box]'. '[clinical]' marks a gene with no approved agent.
column_semantics.glioma_trials: '<agent> (<n>: <first three NCT ids>)' joined by ' | '. Truncated summary.
column_semantics.withdrawn: Intended as per-gene withdrawn agents; empty in every row (see known_defects).

refreshing.behaviour: Writes a NEW dated file; never overwrites this snapshot.
refreshing.expect_drift: Output WILL differ from this snapshot — both databases have moved since 2026-08-07, and the lost prior-pass artifact cannot be reconstructed.
refreshing.must_record: The refreshed manifest must capture the ChEMBL release, which is the pin missing here.
